description: Thrown into a task at its current `await` when it is cancelled. A `BaseException` since 3.8, so `except Exception` does not catch it.
Catching `CancelledError` without re-raising it: the task keeps running and whoever cancelled it waits forever.
An async context manager (3.11) that cancels its block at the deadline and raises `TimeoutError` after the block has unwound.
Awaits one awaitable with a deadline, cancelling it on expiry; built on `timeout()` since 3.12.
Protects an inner task from cancellation of its awaiter; the awaiter still sees `CancelledError`, and someone must keep a reference to the inner task.
